name: Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Iced Carmine'
story_html: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Iced Carmine' updates the legacy model with a pastel color scheme, highlighted by a pink textile upper with a tonal suede forefoot overlay and breathable quarter panel netting. Semi-translucent TPU is utilized on the molded eyelets and signature support wings, along with a heel tab marked with Jumpman branding. A second Jumpman icon decorates the woven tongue tag. The sneaker sits atop a cream-colored polyurethane midsole, fitted with visible Air-Sole cushioning in the heel and supported by a translucent rubber outsole underfoot.
